segments.text: Welcome to the 6th lecture of this MOOC, Introduction to Virus Management.
segments.zh: 欢迎收听本慕课“生物风险管理导论”的第六讲。

segments.text: In this lecture, I will be discussing the World Health Organization Laboratory Biosafety Manual
segments.zh: 在这一讲中，我将讨论世界卫生组织《实验室生物安全手册》

segments.text: and the Pathogen Safety Data Sheets.
segments.zh: 和病原体安全数据表。

segments.text: These are essential guidelines in order to assess the risk posed by known biological agents.
segments.zh: 它们是评估已知生物因子风险的重要指南。

segments.text: Please note that all risk assessment must be done using known biological agents as a reference.
segments.zh: 请注意，所有风险评估都必须以已知生物因子为参照来进行。

segments.text: We cannot conduct a risk assessment for unknown biological agents.
segments.zh: 我们无法对未知生物因子开展风险评估。

segments.text: Welcome back to this lecture on risk assessment.
segments.zh: 欢迎回到这一讲关于风险评估的内容。

segments.text: In today's lecture, I will discuss the Pathogen Safety with Data Sheets
segments.zh: 在今天这一讲中，我将讨论病原体安全数据表，

segments.text: as well as specific guidelines in the World Health Organization Laboratory Biosafety Manual
segments.zh: 以及世界卫生组织《实验室生物安全手册》中

segments.text: pertaining to risk assessment.
segments.zh: 与风险评估有关的具体指南。

segments.text: The learning objectives for this lecture are as follows.
segments.zh: 本讲的学习目标如下。

segments.text: I will introduce you to the process of risk assessment for a known biological agent.
segments.zh: 我将向大家介绍对已知生物因子开展风险评估的过程。

segments.text: Please take note that risk assessment can only be conducted for known biological agents.
segments.zh: 请注意，只能对已知生物因子开展风险评估。

segments.text: We cannot conduct a risk assessment for unknown biological agents
segments.zh: 我们无法对未知生物因子开展风险评估，

segments.text: as the risk is not perceptible or the risk is unknown.
segments.zh: 因为其风险无法感知，或者说风险是未知的。

segments.text: We will discuss the key points that must be addressed during risk assessment
segments.zh: 我们会讨论在风险评估过程中必须解决的、

segments.text: pertaining to the characteristics of the pathogen.
segments.zh: 与病原体特性有关的要点。

segments.text: And we will also discuss the Pathogen Safety Data Sheets,
segments.zh: 我们还会讨论病原体安全数据表，

segments.text: which is a very important document that is utilized currently by risk managers across the world.
segments.zh: 这是一份非常重要的文件，目前被全世界的风险管理者使用。

segments.text: And we have to be thankful to the Government of Canada for developing this excellent resource.
segments.zh: 我们要感谢加拿大政府编制了这份优秀的资源。

segments.text: The learning outcomes for this module are as follows.
segments.zh: 本模块的学习成果如下。

segments.text: Upon completion of this module, I want you to demonstrate the ability to develop a questionnaire
segments.zh: 完成本模块后，我希望大家能够展示制定风险评估问卷

segments.text: or an instrument for risk assessment, address specific criteria pertaining to risk assessment
segments.zh: 或工具的能力，能够根据自己当地的情况

segments.text: based on your own localized situation, and apply the information from the PSDS
segments.zh: 处理与风险评估有关的具体标准，并运用PSDS中的信息

segments.text: to assess the risk posed by a known biological agent.
segments.zh: 来评估已知生物因子带来的风险。

segments.text: Risk assessment functions within a scope.
segments.zh: 风险评估是在一定范围内进行的。

segments.text: There are risks that are within the scope of an assessment
segments.zh: 有些风险在评估范围之内，

segments.text: and risks that are beyond the scope of an assessment.
segments.zh: 有些风险超出评估范围。

segments.text: This is the iceberg analogy in which this is the risk that you see
segments.zh: 这就是冰山类比：这是你看得见、

segments.text: and which you perceive, and this is the risk which you do not see and cannot perceive.
segments.zh: 能感知的风险，而这是你看不见、无法感知的风险。

segments.text: The World Health Organization Laboratory Biosafety Manual
segments.zh: 世界卫生组织《实验室生物安全手册》

segments.text: contains specific guidelines for microbial logical risk assessment.
segments.zh: 包含微生物风险评估的具体指南。

segments.text: These focus on specific criteria or characteristics of the microbe,
segments.zh: 这些指南关注微生物的具体标准或特性，

segments.text: such as the pathogenicity of the microbe,
segments.zh: 比如微生物的致病性、

segments.text: the potential outcome of exposure in terms of morbidity and mortality,
segments.zh: 暴露在发病和死亡方面的可能后果、

segments.text: the natural route of infection, other routes of infection,
segments.zh: 自然感染途径、其他感染途径、

segments.text: stability of the biological agent in the environment,
segments.zh: 生物因子在环境中的稳定性、

segments.text: concentration and culture volume of the biological agent
segments.zh: 就具体实验室操作程序或实验室作业而言

segments.text: with respect to the specific laboratory procedure or laboratory operation,
segments.zh: 生物因子的浓度和培养体积，

segments.text: as well as the presence of a suitable host or vector
segments.zh: 以及是否存在适宜的宿主或媒介

segments.text: for transmission of the biological agent,
segments.zh: 来传播该生物因子、

segments.text: the priori information available from researchers
segments.zh: 研究人员和其他研究中关于该生物因子的

segments.text: and other studies pertaining to that particular biological agent,
segments.zh: 先验信息、

segments.text: specific laboratory procedures which increase the risk of exposure
segments.zh: 会增加暴露风险的具体实验室操作程序，

segments.text: such as pipetting, centrifugation and extraction of nucleic acids,
segments.zh: 比如移液、离心和核酸提取、

segments.text: any genetic manipulation of the organism
segments.zh: 对该生物体的任何基因操作，

segments.text: in case of genetically modified organism
segments.zh: 比如对于转基因生物，

segments.text: which has been incorporated or endowed with specific traits
segments.zh: 是否被赋予了某些特定性状，

segments.text: such as the increase in host range or the transmission,
segments.zh: 例如宿主范围扩大或传播能力增强，

segments.text: local availability of effective prophylaxis or therapeutic interventions
segments.zh: 以及当地针对该生物因子能否获得

segments.text: with respect to that particular biological agent.
segments.zh: 有效的预防或治疗干预措施。

segments.text: Please take note that each biological risk assessment
segments.zh: 请注意，每一次生物风险评估

segments.text: must be conducted for a specific biological agent.
segments.zh: 都必须针对特定的生物因子进行。

segments.text: For instance, if you have developed a risk assessment
segments.zh: 例如，如果你针对结核分枝杆菌

segments.text: for mycobacterium tuberculosis,
segments.zh: 做了一次风险评估，

segments.text: the same risk assessment cannot be utilized for pseudomonas,
segments.zh: 同一份风险评估不能用于假单胞菌、

segments.text: agenosa or coronavirus.
segments.zh: 铜绿假单胞菌或冠状病毒。

segments.text: The risk assessment must also take into account
segments.zh: 风险评估还必须考虑

segments.text: the current availability of facilities
segments.zh: 当前设施的可用情况

segments.text: as well as the training elements.
segments.zh: 以及培训方面的要素。

segments.text: This is a specific questionnaire or an instrument for risk assessment.
segments.zh: 这是一份具体的风险评估问卷或工具。

segments.text: Now, the questions have to be very specific
segments.zh: 这些问题必须非常具体，

segments.text: and the answer will be either yes or no.
segments.zh: 答案是“是”或“否”。

segments.text: This is an example which you can adopt or adapt
segments.zh: 这只是一个示例，你们可以直接采用，也可以根据

segments.text: to your own respective facilities.
segments.zh: 各自设施的情况加以调整。

segments.text: The first question is, has the biological agent
segments.zh: 第一个问题是：该生物因子

segments.text: been reported to be a pathogen?
segments.zh: 是否已有报道是病原体？

segments.text: In this case, prior information is required, a prior report.
segments.zh: 在这里需要既有信息，也就是以往的报道。

segments.text: The next question focuses on morbidity.
segments.zh: 下一个问题关注发病。

segments.text: Does exposure to the biological agent lead to morbidity?
segments.zh: 接触该生物因子是否会导致发病？

segments.text: So you have yes or no, as the case may be.
segments.zh: 根据情况回答“是”或“否”。

segments.text: The route of infection, is it via inhalation?
segments.zh: 感染途径，是否经由吸入？

segments.text: So this may then lead to your risk mitigation strategy,
segments.zh: 这会影响你的风险缓解策略，

segments.text: which involves the usage of respiratory protection
segments.zh: 比如针对吸入途径

segments.text: for inhalation such as masks.
segments.zh: 使用口罩等呼吸防护用品。

segments.text: Route of infection via contact, yes or no?
segments.zh: 感染途径是否经由接触，是或否？

segments.text: Stability in the environment,
segments.zh: 在环境中的稳定性，

segments.text: is the biological agent viable outside of the host
segments.zh: 该生物因子在宿主体外是否存活，

segments.text: or does it basically get degraded in the environment,
segments.zh: 还是像大多数病毒那样

segments.text: as in the case of most viruses?
segments.zh: 在环境中基本上会降解？

segments.text: Genetic modifications which may have been carried out
segments.zh: 研究人员可能进行过的

segments.text: by the researchers and the availability of treatment.
segments.zh: 基因改造，以及是否有治疗方法。

segments.text: These are the basic questions which you must address
segments.zh: 这些就是作为生物风险管理者

segments.text: as a virus manager.
segments.zh: 必须解决的基本问题。

segments.text: We then move on to some of the questions
segments.zh: 接下来是一些

segments.text: which you must pose to your laboratory workers
segments.zh: 你必须向实验室工作人员

segments.text: or your principal investigators.
segments.zh: 或课题负责人提出的问题。

segments.text: The first question pertains to training.
segments.zh: 第一个问题与培训有关。

segments.text: Has adequate training been provided to the laboratory workers?
segments.zh: 是否已为实验室工作人员提供了充分的培训？

segments.text: If not, additional training must be provided.
segments.zh: 如果没有，就必须提供额外培训。

segments.text: So it's either yes or no.
segments.zh: 所以答案是“是”或“否”。

segments.text: Contingency plans.
segments.zh: 应急计划。

segments.text: These must be put into place in the event of a spill
segments.zh: 必须针对发生溢洒

segments.text: or in the event of a breach of containment.
segments.zh: 或防护失效的情况制定应急计划。

segments.text: The SOPs must be developed.
segments.zh: 必须制定标准操作规程。

segments.text: And if there's a yes, you click on yes.
segments.zh: 如果有，就勾选“是”。

segments.text: If there's a no, you just select no.
segments.zh: 如果没有，就选“否”。

segments.text: Facility.
segments.zh: 设施。

segments.text: And the facility pertains to the essential equipment,
segments.zh: 设施这一项涉及必备设备，

segments.text: which is based on the risk group.
segments.zh: 而必备设备取决于危险度等级。

segments.text: One of the essential equipments,
segments.zh: 我前面讨论过的

segments.text: which I've discussed earlier, is the biological safety cabinet.
segments.zh: 必备设备之一就是生物安全柜。

segments.text: The availability of the personal protective equipment.
segments.zh: 个人防护装备是否齐备。

segments.text: The availability of the waste disposal system
segments.zh: 是否有废物处置系统，

segments.text: to prevent release of the biological agent
segments.zh: 以防止生物因子释放

segments.text: into the environment or breach of the secondary containment.
segments.zh: 到环境中或造成二级防护失效。

segments.text: The security of the facility,
segments.zh: 设施的安保情况，

segments.text: as well as specific SOPs related to managing the pathogen.
segments.zh: 以及与管理该病原体有关的具体标准操作规程。

segments.text: As you can see,
segments.zh: 可以看到，

segments.text: most of these questions pertain to processes
segments.zh: 这些问题大多涉及设施内部的

segments.text: within the facility itself and the specific controls.
segments.zh: 各种过程以及具体的控制措施。

segments.text: And one must conduct this kind of a risk assessment
segments.zh: 在进入风险缓解之前，

segments.text: prior to moving on to risk mitigation.
segments.zh: 必须先开展这样的风险评估。

segments.text: We now move on to the pathogen safety data sheets.
segments.zh: 下面我们来看病原体安全数据表。

segments.text: I will be discussing the template itself
segments.zh: 我会讨论这个模板本身

segments.text: and the various criteria which are described in the templates.
segments.zh: 以及模板中所述的各项标准。

segments.text: This is the pathogen safety data sheet website.
segments.zh: 这是病原体安全数据表的网站。

segments.text: It is a current document which is updated
segments.zh: 它是一份随着新信息出现而不断更新的

segments.text: as information becomes available.
segments.zh: 现行文件。

segments.text: And as I mentioned earlier,
segments.zh: 正如我前面提到的，

segments.text: I would like to thank the Government of Canada
segments.zh: 我要感谢加拿大政府

segments.text: for developing this excellent resource material,
segments.zh: 编制了这份优秀的资源材料，

segments.text: which is a lifesaver for many biorisk managers.
segments.zh: 它对许多生物风险管理者来说都是救命法宝。

segments.text: This is the Android version,
segments.zh: 这是安卓版本，

segments.text: which is available in the form of an app.
segments.zh: 以应用程序的形式提供。

segments.text: You can also find it for other mobile phones,
segments.zh: 你也可以在其他手机上找到它，

segments.text: such as the Apple.
segments.zh: 比如苹果手机。

segments.text: There are nine sections,
segments.zh: 模板中共描述了

segments.text: which are described in the template.
segments.zh: 九个部分。

segments.text: And if you key in the biological agent
segments.zh: 如果你在这个病原体安全数据表网站的

segments.text: into the search engine
segments.zh: 搜索框中

segments.text: on this particular pathogen safety data sheet website,
segments.zh: 输入某种生物因子，

segments.text: it will then direct you to these sections.
segments.zh: 它就会把你引导到这些部分。

segments.text: And the section describes the infectious agent
segments.zh: 这些部分描述感染性因子

segments.text: as well as the characteristics of the infectious agent.
segments.zh: 以及感染性因子的特性。

segments.text: I will go through the sections one at a time.
segments.zh: 我会逐一讲解各个部分。

segments.text: And this will clarify any questions pertaining to the sections
segments.zh: 这样就能澄清关于各个部分

segments.text: and their respective content.
segments.zh: 及其内容的任何疑问。

segments.text: So section one focuses on the infectious agent.
segments.zh: 第一部分着重讲感染性因子。

segments.text: The scientific name, the agent type,
segments.zh: 学名、因子类型、

segments.text: whether it's a virus, bacterium, fungus,
segments.zh: 会标明它是病毒、细菌、真菌

segments.text: or prion is indicated.
segments.zh: 还是朊病毒。

segments.text: The taxonomy is indicated in terms of its nomenclature
segments.zh: 分类学一栏按其命名和分类

segments.text: and classification.
segments.zh: 加以标明。

segments.text: The synonyms, common names,
segments.zh: 还有同义名、俗名、

segments.text: the characteristics of the biological agent
segments.zh: 生物因子的特性，

segments.text: in terms of its culture characteristics
segments.zh: 包括其培养特性

segments.text: as well as requirement for a specific medium.
segments.zh: 以及对特定培养基的需求。

segments.text: The brief description of the biological agent itself
segments.zh: 对生物因子本身

segments.text: and its life cycle.
segments.zh: 及其生命周期的简要描述。

segments.text: The properties of the infectious agent,
segments.zh: 感染性因子的性质，

segments.text: which relate to its properties outside of the host.
segments.zh: 也就是它在宿主体外的性质。

segments.text: Section two focuses on hazard identification.
segments.zh: 第二部分着重讲危害识别。

segments.text: In this section,
segments.zh: 在这一部分，

segments.text: the pathogenity and toxicity are addressed.
segments.zh: 讨论致病性和毒性。

segments.text: Communicability,
segments.zh: 传染性，

segments.text: the ability of the biological agent
segments.zh: 即生物因子

segments.text: to be transmitted across the community.
segments.zh: 在社区中传播的能力。

segments.text: The epidemiology, the host range.
segments.zh: 流行病学、宿主范围。

segments.text: The infectious dose and the incubation period.
segments.zh: 感染剂量和潜伏期。

segments.text: The incubation period is the duration
segments.zh: 潜伏期是从接触生物因子

segments.text: between the exposure to the biological agent
segments.zh: 到出现症状之间

segments.text: and the manifestation of the symptoms.
segments.zh: 的时间。

segments.text: Section three focuses on dissemination.
segments.zh: 第三部分着重讲散播。

segments.text: It indicates if a reservoir exists.
segments.zh: 它会标明是否存在储存宿主。

segments.text: The zoonosis and river zoonosis
segments.zh: 人畜共患和反向人畜共患，

segments.text: is the biological agent transmitted via an animal
segments.zh: 即该生物因子是否通过动物

segments.text: and specific vectors.
segments.zh: 和特定媒介传播。

segments.text: So the reservoir for the biological agent
segments.zh: 所以该生物因子的储存宿主

segments.text: may be a human host or it may also be an animal host
segments.zh: 可能是人类宿主，也可能是动物宿主

segments.text: or an insect.
segments.zh: 或昆虫。

segments.text: Section four focuses on the stability
segments.zh: 第四部分着重讲生物因子的

segments.text: and viability of the biological agent.
segments.zh: 稳定性和存活力。

segments.text: As you must be well aware by now,
segments.zh: 相信大家现在已经很清楚，

segments.text: there are multiple cases of drug resistance
segments.zh: 微生物中有大量耐药

segments.text: or antibiotic resistance in microbes.
segments.zh: 或抗生素耐药的情况。

segments.text: And these have been reported across the world.
segments.zh: 这类情况在世界各地都有报道。

segments.text: And this must be addressed in terms of risk assessment
segments.zh: 在针对稳定性和存活力的风险评估中

segments.text: for stability and viability.
segments.zh: 必须讨论这一点。

segments.text: The susceptibility to disinfectants is another issue
segments.zh: 对消毒剂的敏感性是另一个

segments.text: which must be addressed as disinfectants
segments.zh: 必须讨论的问题，因为在实验室的

segments.text: are constantly used in the laboratory
segments.zh: 日常清洁中

segments.text: in routine cleanup.
segments.zh: 会不断使用消毒剂。

segments.text: The conditions for physical inactivation,
segments.zh: 物理灭活的条件，

segments.text: which may include heat and the application of steam
segments.zh: 可能包括加热、使用蒸汽

segments.text: or ultraviolet radiation,
segments.zh: 或紫外线照射，

segments.text: as well as the ability of the microorganism
segments.zh: 以及该微生物

segments.text: to survive outside of the host.
segments.zh: 在宿主体外存活的能力。

segments.text: All of these pertain to the stability
segments.zh: 所有这些都与微生物

segments.text: and viability of the microorganism
segments.zh: 或生物因子的稳定性

segments.text: or biological agent.
segments.zh: 和存活力有关。

segments.text: Section five must address the available
segments.zh: 第五部分必须说明可用的

segments.text: first aid and medical measures,
segments.zh: 急救和医学措施，

segments.text: which include surveillance of the laboratory personnel.
segments.zh: 其中包括对实验室人员的监测。

segments.text: This may be in the terms of a baseline serum study.
segments.zh: 这可以采取基线血清学研究的形式。

segments.text: First aid and treatment in the event
segments.zh: 还有发生防护失效时的

segments.text: of breach of containment,
segments.zh: 急救和治疗、

segments.text: vaccination if it exists,
segments.zh: 如果有疫苗的话疫苗接种，

segments.text: and profile access of preventive treatment
segments.zh: 以及为实验室工作人员提供的

segments.text: for the laboratory workers.
segments.zh: 预防性措施，即预防性治疗。

segments.text: Section six focuses on laboratory hazards.
segments.zh: 第六部分着重讲实验室危害。

segments.text: Laboratory hazards are the result of working
segments.zh: 实验室危害是处理

segments.text: with the biological agent.
segments.zh: 生物因子所带来的。

segments.text: And these are likely to be LAIs
segments.zh: 这些危害很可能是LAI，

segments.text: or laboratory acquired infection
segments.zh: 即实验室获得性感染，

segments.text: or hospital acquired infections,
segments.zh: 或者视情况为
